title: Biotechnology in Microbiology
notes: The use of microbial biotechnology is described below: 1.
In Medicine: The concept of microbial biotechnology is used in human and veterinary medicine by the following ways: a.
Antibiotics: Antibiotics are substances obtained from microorganisms that help in controlling different types of diseases.
They are obtained from different types of microorganisms.
Vaccines: Vaccines are the substances derived from microorganisms used to immunize against disease.
Vaccines are produced by using the concept of fermentation technology and recombinant DNA technology.
The use of vaccines such as smallpox, polio, tetanus etc.
led to the virtual elimination of these diseases in regions of the world where the vaccines have been deployed.
